queries: WITH c AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH c AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - av.a) AS avg_excess_over_overall_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.a

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Order-item lines are counted as rows in Order_Items (COUNT(*)), grouped by product_id; products with no order items are not included in the average.
Shares are computed with decimal (non-integer) division and results are left unrounded.
If no product has a share above the average (e.g., all equal), the query returns a single row with NULL values (SUM/AVG over no rows).

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Products are only those appearing in Order_Items (products with no order items are not included in the average across products). Each row in Order_Items is one order-item line, so the count per product is COUNT(*).
The 'average share' in the output is the average share among the above-average products only, not the overall average share.
If no product has a share strictly above the average (all equal), the query returns a row with NULLs.

responses.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - av.a) AS avg_excess_over_overall_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.a

assumptions.assumption: Each row in Order_Items counts as one order-item line (COUNT(*) per product_id), regardless of the product_quantity value.
Only products appearing in Order_Items are included in the 'all products' set for the average share (products with no order items are excluded).
Shares are computed with decimal (non-integer) division and no rounding.
